# ProcessColision

Auto-generated Ruby on Rails + Sidekiq project for BPMN process `Process_Colision` (Colisiones y acentos).

## Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env
bundle install
bundle exec rspec
```

## Running with Sidekiq (HTTP Service Tasks)

HTTP service tasks whose output is not read by downstream nodes are enqueued via Sidekiq (`perform_async`). Make sure Redis is running and start both Rails and the Sidekiq worker:

```bash
redis-server
bundle exec sidekiq -C config/sidekiq.yml
bundle exec rails server
```

## Endpoint

- `GET /health`
- `POST /workflows/process_colision/execute`

class WorkflowsController < ApplicationController
  def health
    render json: { status: "ok", workflow: "Process_Colision" }
  end

  def execute
    payload = params.fetch(:payload, params.except(:controller, :action)).to_unsafe_h
    result = Workflows::ProcessColisionWorkflow.call(payload)
    render json: result, status: :ok
  end
end

module Jobs
  class EnviarCorreo2HttpJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    sidekiq_options queue: :default, retry: 3

    ENDPOINT_URL = ENV.fetch("ENVIAR_CORREO2_HTTP_JOB_URL", "https://api.example.com/m2")
    HTTP_METHOD = "POST"
    OPEN_TIMEOUT = ENV.fetch("HTTP_OPEN_TIMEOUT", "5").to_i
    READ_TIMEOUT = ENV.fetch("HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT", "15").to_i
    DEFAULT_HEADERS = {}.freeze

    def perform(context = {})
      ctx = context.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
      uri = URI.parse(ENDPOINT_URL)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == "https")
      http.open_timeout = OPEN_TIMEOUT
      http.read_timeout = READ_TIMEOUT

      headers = DEFAULT_HEADERS.dup
      auth_token = ENV["ENVIAR_CORREO2_HTTP_JOB_AUTH_TOKEN"]
      headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{auth_token}" if auth_token && !auth_token.empty?

      request_class = Net::HTTP.const_get(HTTP_METHOD.capitalize)
      request = request_class.new(uri.request_uri, headers)
      payload = {
          "to" => ctx[:b]
      }
      request.body = JSON.generate(payload)

      response = http.request(request)
      parsed_body = JSON.parse(response.body) rescue response.body

      ctx
    end
  end
end

# Auto-generated by SHTLNG FlowSpec -> Ruby on Rails Compiler
# Process ID: Process_Colision (Colisiones y acentos)

module Workflows
  class ProcessColisionWorkflow
    attr_reader :context, :visited_nodes, :enqueued_jobs

    MAX_STEPS = 100

    def self.call(initial_context = {})
      new(initial_context).call
    end

    def initialize(initial_context = {})
      @context = initial_context.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
      @visited_nodes = []
      @enqueued_jobs = []
      @join_arrivals = Hash.new(0)
    end

    def call
      queue = [:start_1]
      steps = 0

      while (current_node = queue.shift) && steps < MAX_STEPS
        steps += 1
        @visited_nodes << current_node.to_s
        next_nodes = dispatch_node(current_node)
        queue.concat(Array(next_nodes))
      end

      {
        completed: true,
        status: @enqueued_jobs.empty? ? "completed" : "enqueued",
        visited_nodes: @visited_nodes,
        enqueued_jobs: @enqueued_jobs,
        context: @context
      }
    end

    private

    def dispatch_node(node_id)
      case node_id
      when :start_1
        execute_start1
      when :task_1
        execute_task1
      when :task_2
        execute_task2
      when :task_3
        execute_task3
      when :task_4
        execute_task4
      when :task_5
        execute_task5
      when :task_6
        execute_task6
      when :task_7
        execute_task7
      when :task_8
        execute_task8
      when :task_9
        execute_task9
      when :task_10
        execute_task10
      when :task_11
        execute_task11
      when :task_12
        execute_task12
      when :end_1
        execute_end1
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Unknown workflow node: #{node_id}"
      end
    end

    # [start] Inicio (start_1)
    def execute_start1
      [:task_1]
    end

    # [user_task] Cotización ¡Rápida! (task_1)
    def execute_task1
      form = Forms::CotizacionRapidaForm.new(@context.slice(:a))
      form.validate!
      [:task_2]
    end

    # [user_task] Cotizacion rapida (task_2)
    def execute_task2
      form = Forms::CotizacionRapida2Form.new(@context.slice(:b))
      form.validate!
      [:task_3]
    end

    # [user_task] COTIZACIÓN-RÁPIDA (task_3)
    def execute_task3
      form = Forms::CotizacionRapida3Form.new(@context.slice(:c))
      form.validate!
      [:task_4]
    end

    # [user_task] Paso 2 de 10 (task_4)
    def execute_task4
      form = Forms::Paso2De10Form.new(@context.slice(:d))
      form.validate!
      [:task_5]
    end

    # [service_task] Enviar correo (task_5)
    def execute_task5
      jid = Jobs::EnviarCorreoHttpJob.perform_async(@context.transform_keys(&:to_s))
      @enqueued_jobs << { node_id: "task_5", job_class: "Jobs::EnviarCorreoHttpJob", jid: jid }
      [:task_6]
    end

    # [service_task] Enviar  Correo! (task_6)
    def execute_task6
      jid = Jobs::EnviarCorreo2HttpJob.perform_async(@context.transform_keys(&:to_s))
      @enqueued_jobs << { node_id: "task_6", job_class: "Jobs::EnviarCorreo2HttpJob", jid: jid }
      [:task_7]
    end

    # [service_task] Delegar uno (task_7)
    def execute_task7
      @context = Services::CalculadoraService.call(@context)
      [:task_8]
    end

    # [service_task] Delegar dos (task_8)
    def execute_task8
      @context = Services::Calculadora2Service.call(@context)
      [:task_9]
    end

    # [business_rule_task] Regla uno (task_9)
    def execute_task9
      @context[:r1] = Services::Decisions::RiesgoCreditoDecisionService.evaluate(@context)
      [:task_10]
    end

    # [business_rule_task] Regla dos (task_10)
    def execute_task10
      @context[:decision_result] = Services::Decisions::RiesgoCredito2DecisionService.evaluate(@context)
      [:task_11]
    end

    # [service_task] ??? (task_11)
    def execute_task11
      [:task_12]
    end

    # [call_activity] Llamar (task_12)
    def execute_task12
      sub_result = Workflows::SubProcesoComunWorkflow.call(@context)
      @context.merge!(sub_result[:context]) if sub_result.is_a?(Hash) && sub_result[:context]
      [:end_1]
    end

    # [end] Fin (end_1)
    def execute_end1
      []
    end
  end
end

# Auto-generated RSpec suite for Workflows::ProcessColisionWorkflow

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe Workflows::ProcessColisionWorkflow, type: :workflow do
  describe ".call" do
    let(:sample_payload) do
      { a: "sample_a", b: "sample_b", c: "sample_c", d: "sample_d" }
    end

    it "executes the workflow from start to an end event" do
      result = described_class.call(sample_payload)
      expect(result[:completed]).to be(true)
      expect(result[:visited_nodes]).to include("start_1")
    end

    it "reports Sidekiq enqueue status consistently when HTTP jobs run asynchronously" do
      result = described_class.call(sample_payload)
      expected_status = result[:enqueued_jobs].empty? ? "completed" : "enqueued"
      expect(result[:status]).to eq(expected_status)
    end

    it "supports formal execution trace #1 ending at end_1" do
      # Formal Trace: start_1 -> task_1 -> task_2 -> task_3 -> task_4 -> task_5 -> task_6 -> task_7 -> task_8 -> task_9 -> task_10 -> task_11 -> task_12 -> end_1
      expect("end_1").not_to be_empty
    end
  end
end
